label: NPM1::ALK

sections.text: NPM1 encodes nucleophosmin, a nucleolar protein involved in ribosome assembly and protein trafficking.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.
The fusion uses NPM1-mediated oligomerization to activate the ALK kinase and downstream survival pathways. It is the principal fusion in ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

Crizotinib has a US indication for relapsed or refractory systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma in children aged at least 1 year and young adults. Its efficacy and safety for that indication were not established in older adults in the cited label.
